text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although her physical condition has previously prevented her from getting the most out of summer camp, Mejiro Ardan brims with excitement as she believes things will be different this year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With our sights set on our autumn goal, a red-hot summer camp gets underway!
